meta.title: Grace's Flat
meta.textType: functional: an email that describes a flat

paragraphs: On Monday, June twenty-second, Lily opened her first email from Grace. Grace was her new pen pal. In Lily's room, Mia sat next to Lily and looked at the screen. The subject of the email was "My flat." Lily read the first lines out loud. "Dear Lily, my name is Grace, and I am eleven." "I live in a flat with my mom and dad." "Our flat is on the ninth floor." "There is a lift in our building, and it is very fast."

"The living room has a gray sofa, a blue carpet, and many cushions." "The sofa is very comfortable." "In the evening, the room is warm." "The cushions feel like soft clouds." "The kitchen has a cooker and a fridge." "At night, the fridge sounds like a quiet bee." "The bathroom has a shower and a yellow towel." "My room has a bed, a desk, and a wardrobe." "I have white curtains, and my room is always tidy." "My desk is small, but it is my favorite piece of furniture."

"My favorite place is the balcony." "I sit on a cushion and draw there after school." "The view of the park makes me happy." "The big trees look like a green blanket." "What is your house like?" "Please write to me soon." "Best wishes, Grace." "P.S. How is Pip?"

Mia smiled at the last line. "Grace likes Pip already," she said. "Her flat sounds like a nice place," said Lily. Lily took a sheet of paper and drew a plan of her own house. She drew the kitchen, the living room, and her room. "My house has a garden, but it has no lift," she said. "What shall we tell Grace about Pip?" asked Mia. "We can tell her that Pip loves his red ball," said Lily. Lily put the plan next to the laptop and began her reply.
text.summary: Lily reads the first email from her pen pal Grace. Grace tells about the rooms of her flat and her favorite place, the balcony, and Lily draws a plan of her own house.
